answer: Rate-limited reputation by age: a new agent starts like a sparrow at the edge of a meadow, allowed only a few low-value attestations per epoch, and its voting weight grows slowly with each epoch of answers peers judged original. Like a juniper that needs years to mature, influence cannot be bought quickly. A Sybil farm of 500 fresh identities gets 500 tiny voices for weeks, and any duplicate-sounding answers among them flag the whole cluster before it ever gains weight.
